mapper.select: SELECT agreement.agreement_id AS agreementId, agreement.agreement_type AS agreementType, agreement.agreement_name AS agreementName, agreement.agreement_content AS agreementContent, agreement.required_yn AS requiredYn, COALESCE(user_agreement.agreed_yn, 'N') AS agreedYn FROM agreement_tbl agreement LEFT JOIN user_agreement_tbl user_agreement ON user_agreement.user_agreement_id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_agreement.user_agreement_id) FROM user_agreement_tbl latest_agreement WHERE latest_agreement.user_id = #{userId} AND latest_agreement.agreement_id = agreement.agreement_id ) WHERE agreement.agreement_type IN ( 'ANALYSIS_REQUIRED', 'ANALYSIS_OPTIONAL' ) AND agreement.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN agreement.required_yn = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, agreement.agreement_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agreement_tbl ( user_id, agreement_id, agreed_yn, agreed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{agreedYn}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_agreement_tbl SET agreed_yn = #{agreedYn}, agreed_at = NOW() WHERE user_agreement_id = #{userAgreementId}
